newsitem.title: USA: St. Michael 885, Minn. $1.260 mln won by FBS Investment Services Inc. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: St. Michael 885, Minn. $1.260 mln won by FBS Investment Services Inc. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to clarify FBS Investment Services won the bonds and not Piper Jaffray)

FBS Investment Services Inc (corrects) said it won $1.260 million of St. Michael-Albertville ISD 885, Minn., general obligation school building refunding bonds, Series 1996 B, with a true interest cost of 4.5799 percent.
